# Convert declination from degree-minute-second format to decimal degrees
def dms_to_decimal(dms_str):
    # Remove 'degree' and split by '′' and '″'
    dms_str = dms_str.replace('degree', '').replace('″', '')
    parts = dms_str.split('′')
    degrees = float(parts[0])
    minutes_seconds = parts[1].split('m')
    minutes = float(minutes_seconds[0])
    seconds = float(minutes_seconds[1].replace('s', ''))
    return degrees + minutes/60 + seconds/3600
